Prespecify a padding-only ablation with identical GRU4Rec architecture, hyperparameters, preprocessing seed 0 and training seed 42. Prefer a fixed final epoch for both arms; if selecting checkpoints, freeze the evaluation schedule, selection metric and earliest-epoch tie rule beforehand. Retain one checkpoint/category. Define an explicit validation-query cap covering every checkpoint evaluation, trial and diagnostic inspection; report scheduled and actual queries, including unsuccessful trials. Count each four-category sweep as four dataset evaluations. Query limits reduce adaptive overfitting but do not eliminate it; validation-selected gains remain exploratory until untouched held-out evaluation. [Holdout reuse research](https://papers.nips.cc/paper/5993-generalization-in-adaptive-data-analysis-and-holdout-reuse.pdf)

Prespecify the effect as corrected-minus-baseline macro HR@10: average the four category-specific mean paired hit differences. Bootstrap 200 users with replacement within each category, retaining each user’s baseline/corrected pair and fixed candidates; average the four resampled category effects. Specify, for example, 10,000 replicates, bootstrap seed 42 and a two-sided 95% percentile interval. Report category effects and the macro effect in percentage points. These intervals describe user-sampling uncertainty conditional on fitted checkpoints and candidate sets; they do not correct validation-selection optimism or establish generalization to other datasets. [Paired bootstrap documentation](https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/generated/scipy.stats.bootstrap.html)

Account against 43,200 GPU-seconds by summing charged runtime across concurrent trials, including training, diagnostics, debugging and failures; four simultaneous GPU jobs consume four GPU-seconds per elapsed second. Record hardware and per-trial costs; report LLM time and final held-out inference separately. [Reporting guidance](https://neurips.cc/public/guides/PaperChecklist) One training seed cannot estimate initialization or optimization variability. Fixed 99-negative sets leave candidate-sampling variability unmeasured; sampled HR@10 need not preserve full-catalog model rankings. [Sampled-metric analysis](https://ijcai.org/proceedings/2021/651)
